# Interesting Engineering

> > A publication showcasing groundbreaking innovations, emerging technologies, and engineering marvels that shape our future.

Interesting Engineering covers cutting-edge developments across multiple disciplines including sustainable technology, medical innovations, transportation breakthroughs, and unconventional inventions. The site features stories from innovators worldwide, from TrackingPoint's precision firearms to Mars One's colonization plans, highlighting both practical solutions and ambitious future concepts.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable technology and green energy
- Medical innovations and biotechnology
- Solar power and renewable energy
- Smart home and IoT devices
- Drone technology and autonomous systems
- Electric vehicles and transportation
- Space exploration and Mars colonization
- Precision engineering and targeting systems
- Modular construction and housing
- Wearable technology and sensors
- Kickstarter innovations
- Dubai innovations
- Japanese technology
- Military technology applications

## Medical and Health Innovations

- [Diabetes management could be transformed thanks to bionic pancreas](https://interestingengineering.com/science/diabetes-management-could-be-transformed-thanks-to-bionic-pancreas): Boston University bionic pancreas trial shows promise for Type 1 diabetes
- [Deaf Women Hears for the First Time in a Tear Jerking Moment](https://interestingengineering.com/science/deaf-women-hears-for-the-first-time-in-a-tear-jerking-moment): Joanne Milne receives cochlear implants for Usher syndrome at 39

## Sustainable Technology and Green Energy

- [Glow in the Dark Roads Begin Use in Netherlands](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/glow-in-the-dark-roads-begin-use-in-netherlands): Daan Roosegaarde's photoluminescent road markings debut in Oss, Netherlands
- [Sustainable home built with screwdriver in four days](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/sustainable-home-built-with-screwdriver-in-four-days): Multipod Studio's Pop-Up House meets Passivhaus standard, DIY assembly
- [Transparent Coloured Solar Cells](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/transparent-coloured-solar-cells): University of Michigan's Jay Guo develops colored transparent solar cells
- [Solar-Powered Flight!](https://interestingengineering.com/transportation/solar-powered-flight): Solar Impulse HB-SIA by Piccard and Borschberg pioneers solar aviation
- [BMW shows off new solar charging station for your electric car](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/bmw-shows-off-new-solar-charging-station-for-your-car): BMW Solar Carport concept for i3 and i8 electric vehicles in LA
- [You need to see the salt water-powered QUANT e-Sportlimousine](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/you-need-to-see-the-salt-water-powered-quant-e-sportlimousine): NanoFLOWCELL's QUANT e-Sportlimousine uses flow-cell saltwater technology

## Drone and Aviation Technology

- [Gimball: the world's first collision proof drone](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/gimball-collision-proof-drone): Flyability's Gimball drone wins Dubai's Drones for Good competition
- [The future is here. Impressive indoor flight of jetpack is unbelievable!](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/the-future-is-here-impressive-indoor-flight-of-jetpack-is-unbelievable): Jet Pack International demos hydrogen peroxide jetpack at Reagan Building

## Space Exploration

- [Colonization of Mars Begins in 2013](https://interestingengineering.com/science/colonization-of-mars-begins-in-2013): Mars One announces one-way mission to colonize Mars with reality TV funding

## Smart Home and IoT

- [Warm up your house heating the smart way with your smartphone](https://interestingengineering.com/innovation/warm-up-your-homes-radiators-the-smart-way-with-the-help-of-your-smartphone): Radiator Labs' Cozy system brings smart heating to Manhattan apartments
- [Could this dancing traffic light help to improve safety?](https://interestingengineering.com/culture/could-this-dancing-traffic-light-help-to-improve-safety): Smart's Dancing Traffic Light gamifies pedestrian safety in Portugal
